content.user_title: Direct Female Outfit Collages and Transition Videos
content.value_statement: Keeping one character consistent across several outfits and video transitions requires detailed planning. This skill creates linked image prompts, timelines, constraints, and transition directions.
actual_capabilities: Extracts visible character, hairstyle, accessories, outfit, layout, lighting, and pose details from a supplied reference image.
Recommends four to eight distinct parameter sets before generating full prompts.
Creates a linked first-frame collage prompt for one adult character in multiple outfits.
Builds timed transition scripts with actions, expressions, sound cues, fabric motion, and continuity constraints.
Selects from documented transition methods for Hanfu, modern fashion, fantasy styling, and collage formats.
Marks reasonable system-completed defaults when users provide only partial parameters.
limitations: It writes prompts and scripts but does not generate images or render videos.
Reference extraction depends on visible image details and cannot recover hidden or unclear features.
The default workflow targets one adult female character and multi-outfit transformation content.
Complex camera movement combined with several transitions may reduce continuity in short videos.

use_cases.title: Plan a fashion collage
use_cases.description: Create a five-look first-frame prompt with one consistent adult character and a controlled sticker-style layout.

use_cases.title: Convert a reference into a video plan
use_cases.description: Extract visible design anchors from a reference image and extend them into a timed transformation script.

use_cases.title: Develop transition options
use_cases.description: Compare suitable mechanisms for Hanfu, modern fashion, or fantasy outfits before selecting a production direction.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic outfit collage
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-outfit collage prompt for one adult woman. Use a 9:16 studio layout and recommend suitable looks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request without a reference image

prompt_templates.title: Use a reference image
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my reference image. Preserve visible identity, hair, accessories, and layout while planning four additional outfits and an eight-second transition video.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Hanfu transformation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design five coordinated Hanfu looks for one adult character. Use sleeve and fan transitions, then provide image prompts, timeline details, and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a custom timed sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep my supplied character, outfits, camera, and duration locked. Place transitions at [times], compare two mechanisms, then write the final production prompt.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with locked parameters and custom timing

output_examples.input: Recommend concepts for an elegant five-look Hanfu collage.
output: Concept: Cool-toned noblewoman with moon white, pale blue, and silver-gray layers.
Layout: One large central figure with four smaller full-body cutouts.
Transitions: Character overlap and flowing-sleeve coverage.

output_examples.input: Turn my fashion collage into an eight-second transformation video.
output_examples.output: The result locks identity and layout, schedules four outfit changes, directs continuous movement, and adds fabric physics, sound cues, and negative constraints.

output_examples.input: Replace the current transitions but preserve everything else.
output_examples.output: The revised plan retains character, clothing, timing, camera, and layout while replacing only triggers and related actions with two suitable transition options.

best_practices: Provide a clear reference image or describe the adult character, outfits, visual style, and intended platform.
State which parameters are fixed, especially identity, outfit details, duration, aspect ratio, camera, and transition times.
Choose one primary transition method, or alternate no more than two methods in an eight-second video.
anti_patterns: Do not request unrelated single-outfit portraits when no transformation workflow is needed.
Do not combine complex camera motion with four different transition methods in a short sequence.
Do not leave identity anchors unspecified when consistency across all outfits is essential.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images or videos?
faq.answer: No. It produces image prompts, video scripts, timelines, and constraints for compatible generation tools.

faq.question: Can it use an uploaded reference image?
faq.answer: Yes. It can extract visible identity, styling, accessories, composition, lighting, and outfit details from the image.

faq.question: What happens when I omit parameters?
faq.answer: It fills reasonable low-risk defaults and labels them as system-completed values. It asks one question only when essential information is missing.

faq.question: Can I request fewer or more than five outfits?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports three to six outfits and explains the adjusted collage layout before generating the prompts.

faq.question: Which clothing styles are supported?
faq.answer: The documented presets cover Hanfu, modern fashion, fantasy goddess styling, elegant historical looks, and social-media lookbooks.

faq.question: Can it preserve my existing video plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can keep identity, clothing, camera, duration, and layout while replacing only the transition mechanism and related actions.
